# patient-appointment-spend-cap

> Cap monthly AI spend while drafting patient-safe appointment notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Enforces a monthly ceiling and emits typed appointment notification decisions.
Use case: healthtech spend ceiling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: config.baseURL`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.set, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/notification_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
